Install Siyanat App

Run portal in full-screen native app mode

App is ready to install on this device!

iPhone / iPad (Safari)

  1. Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.
  2. Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen" .
  3. Tap "Add" in the top right corner.

Android (Chrome / Firefox / Edge)

  1. Tap the 3-dots menu in the top-right corner.
  2. Select "Install App" or "Add to Home screen".
  3. Follow the prompt to install the Siyanat icon directly to your app launcher.
Once installed, it opens instantly without browser address bars, keeps your sign-in active, and syncs data with Firestore in real-time.

Firestore Database & fm.marol Google Drive Storage Settings

Ensure all module data is permanently saved in Firestore & local backup, and all photos/videos/docs upload to fm.marol@jameasaifiyah.edu Drive.

1. Dual-Layer Real-Time Cloud Sync (Firestore + Local Vault)

Real-Time Cloud Sync Active: Connected to Firebase Firestore (siyanat-housekeeping). Every edit, stock issue, and Excel import automatically syncs live across all PCs and mobile phones in real-time without needing manual buttons.

Firebase Cloud Security & Real-Time Sync: Protected & Active

Your database is securely configured with allow read, write: if request.auth != null;. Any authorized user signed in on PC or mobile automatically reads and writes to Firestore in real-time. You do not need to open your rules to unauthenticated public writes.

Download or restore a complete snapshot of all 9 modules anytime:

2. fm.marol@jameasaifiyah.edu Google Drive Media Bridge

Connects Pest Control, Water Tanks, Machinery, and Cleaning media uploads directly to your fm.marol Google Drive.

Connected to fm.marol Drive
How to get your fm.marol Google Drive Web App URL (1-Time Setup)
  1. Sign in to script.google.com using your fm.marol@jameasaifiyah.edu Google account and click New Project.
  2. Click Copy Apps Script Code above, paste it into Code.gs (replacing existing code), and click Save ().
  3. Click Deploy → New deployment, choose type Web app, set Execute as: Me (fm.marol@jameasaifiyah.edu), and Who has access: Anyone.
  4. Copy the generated Web app URL, paste it in the box above, and click Save Drive Configuration.
